blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed.

movementDuration.title: Movement Duration
movementDuration.description: Set the duration in seconds of the full movement for each device. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field the duration in seconds.

useClosure.title: Use Closure
useClosure.description: Expose covers using the Matter 1.5 Closure device type instead of WindowCovering, to ease integration testing with controllers that support the newer cluster. Requires a matterbridge build with Closure support (development only)

closureCalibration.title: Closure Calibration
closureCalibration.description: Opt in per device to the Closure Calibration optional feature. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field true or false. Only applies when useClosure is enabled (development only)

closureVentilation.title: Closure Ventilation
closureVentilation.description: Opt in per device to the Closure Ventilation optional feature. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field true or false. Only applies when useClosure is enabled (development only)

closurePedestrian.title: Closure Pedestrian
closurePedestrian.description: Opt in per device to the Closure Pedestrian optional feature. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field true or false. Only applies when useClosure is enabled (development only)

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
